2. Mode 2 (second SPACE): Player teleports back to start, and the mode is toggled again
Wait, let me re-examine. The first SPACE was pressed when the player was at rows 8-12, cols 14-18. The player stayed there. Then the player moved DOWN, RIGHT, etc.
The second SPACE was pressed when the player was at rows 32-36, cols 14-18. The player teleported back to rows 8-12, cols 14-18.
So SPACE seems to be a "reset" or "teleport to start" action when pressed from a non-start position. But when pressed at the start position, it enables a different movement mode.
Actually, looking more carefully at the image, the top-left blue square is now blue (not gray). Before the first SPACE, the top-left was blue. After the first SPACE, it became gray. After the second SPACE, it became blue again.
So SPACE toggles a mode:
- Blue top-left: Normal mode (player can only move through black corridors)
- Gray top-left: Special mode (player can move through previously blocked areas)
When SPACE is pressed, the player teleports to the start position and the mode toggles.
Now the player is at rows 14-18, cols 14-18 (after going DOWN from start). The top-left is blue, meaning we're in normal mode. The player can't go RIGHT or DOWN from here in normal mode.
Wait, but the player just moved DOWN from rows 8-12 to rows 14-18. Let me check if the player can move further in this mode.
Actually, looking at the image more carefully, the player is at rows 14-18, cols 14-18 (blue square on the left side of the maze, just below the start). The player tried RIGHT and it didn't move.
Let me think about this differently. The red path shows the solution:
- Vertical segment at cols 39-41 (right side)
- Horizontal segment at rows 38-42 (bottom)
The player needs to follow the red path. But the player is currently in normal mode (blue top-left), which means the player can only move through black corridors.
Maybe the player needs to press SPACE again to toggle to the special mode (gray top-left), then follow the red path?
Let me try pressing SPACE and then moving along the red path.
